scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
One shot.
One kill.
It's not so hard
once you develop the
vision for that style
of battling.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
一击必杀。
一旦你掌握了这种战斗风格的视野，其实并不难。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
The world is in
need of mighty Bowmen
like you. Are you ready for
the awesome responsibility?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
这个世界需要你这样强大的弓箭手。你准备好承担这份重大的责任了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Are you willing to
take the next step and
become a Sniper?
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你愿意迈出下一步，成为神射手吗？

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
当你准备好了，随时欢迎回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回到我这里之前用完所有剩余的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Congratulations!
As a Sniper, I hope
that the minions of evil
will never be safe so
long as they are in
your sight!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
恭喜！
身为神射手，我希望邪恶的爪牙只要出现在你的火狩范围内，就永无宁日！

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
欢迎来到
瓦尔哈拉，
荣誉殿堂。

scripts.text:
[Sniper]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神射手]
请在这里
随意放松。
向勇士们致敬！
